rx_handler: session gate sub_6B9AC requires it first; in data phase 0x06BB08
what_it_does: identify / handshake. Copies the 55-byte FT3D identify frame to the TX staging buffer 0xFEE000, patches 0xFEE035='3' when 0xFF8DDE.7 set, then sub_6BD6E fills: 3-char destination from the USA/JPN/EXP table at 0x06BE28 -> 0xFEE016, 3 bytes from sub_6864 -> 0xFEE019, 6 bytes from 0xFFB05B -> 0xFEE01C, 5 bytes from 0xFF8060 -> 0xFEE02B, then '_' '0'. IN THE DATA PHASE 'V' IS A SOFTWARE RESET: jsr sub_2648; orc #0x80,ccr; jmp 0x2050 (only when 0xFF8DDE bit 7 is clear)

model / destination exchange. Echoes 76 or 74 bytes of the received frame from 0xFF1AC8 into 0xFEE000 and patches 0xFEE006='2', 0xFEE007='0', 0xFEE008='0', 0xFEE01E='1', 0xFEE025='0'. sub_6C652 calls sub_25EAE, sub_6C680 calls sub_2611A, both then set 0xFFB12F/30/31 from 0xFFB3D4
1-byte status get/ack. When 0xFF8DDE.7 and 0xFFB3E5 != 0: clears 0xFFB3E5, sets 0xFFB3E4=1, calls 0x01CA72
11-byte record. Calls sub_6BB6E for a 2-byte value -> 0xFEE007/0xFEE009, then 5 bytes from 0xFF8060 -> 0xFEE00B
position / waypoint record, 72-byte payload: latitude 000.00000, longitude +000.00000, then date/time digits. This is the APRS/GPS position record
header / summary record. 6 template bytes, index via sub_6C10A from 0xFFB3BE, 0xFEEB28/29 -> 0xFEE00E/0F, then 20 bytes from 0xFEEB14 -> 0xFEE010, EOT

block/record read response, selected by 0xFEEAAC (else / 2 / 3). 7 template bytes, a 4-hex-digit record index from 0xFFB3D0 (sub_6CC4A), a 2-hex-digit type from 0xFEEAB0 (sub_6CC04), then 45 / 65 / 90 bytes from 0xFEE944 HEX-ENCODED to 90 / 130 / 180 ASCII chars (sub_6CC4A), EOT. Source 0xFEE944 is the APRS message/beacon store written by sub_6C402
11-byte record, shares the tail of the C path at 0x06BF12
